title: Isandro and the Cellar
author: W. M. Iversen
blurb: Lena Amberdale, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
